subject: Pricing gate takedown: Solstice AI — outstanding discount & forecast status
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ami Lopez <ami.lopez@solstice.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing gate takedown: Solstice AI — outstanding discount & forecast status

Ami — quick note to close the loop for finance. We have Solstice queued as a Q3 commit in the commercial forecast but there are two open items blocking formal commit: the 22% discount ask and a special net-45 payment term request.

Can you confirm by EOD whether Solstice is willing to accept the revised commercial package we proposed (18% discount, standard net-30)? We need confirmation to mark the deal as "commit" for forecasting purposes. If you need another call, we can do 30 mins today — I can pull Karthik and Lauren in.

If you prefer to proceed with the 22% and net-45, we will need a signed exception and Deal Desk approval before finance will count the revenue in the committed forecast. I attached the pricing matrix we used to model the impact.

Next steps I need from you: 
- Confirm acceptance of 18% / net-30 or request formal exception for 22% / net-45
- If exception requested, upload completed procurement paperwork to the DocuSign link Lauren will provide

Appreciate the quick turnaround — it changes our committed number materially.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
(425) 555-0198

Attachment: pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing gate takedown: Solstice AI — outstanding discount & forecast status

Ben — copying Deal Desk and Finance triage. Quick points:

- 22% discount is above our standard concession bands for this ARR profile. Approving at that level requires Director sign-off + Finance acknowledgement of revenue recognition timing change.
- Net-45 pushes cash timing out of the quarter and could disqualify the deal from a Q3 commit unless accompanied by a signed payment plan and legal exception.

Action I recommend:
1) Ask the buyer whether they can compromise to 18% / net-30 (we keep them in commit).
2) If they insist on 22% / net-45, we need completed pricing exception form + PO or signed SOW by 8/27 so finance can decide on commit counting.

I'll start a Deal Desk review now (assigning as high priority). Lauren — can you prepare the exception form and the DocuSign envelope? Vanessa — flag for forecasting update if we get a hard no to 18%.

-Karthik

Attachment: redwood-pricing-exception-form_v1.pdf (form)

From: Ami Lopez <ami.lopez@solstice.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@solstice.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing gate takedown: Solstice AI — outstanding discount & forecast status

Ben / team — thanks for the transparency. Internally we ran this up to procurement and finance. Our pragmatic position: Solstice can move to 18% with a 30-day trial extension (additional month of usage, no extra cost) and standard net-30. That would allow our CFO to keep this in the Q3 spend plan.

If Redwood can accept the minor extension, we'll sign the SOW this week. Otherwise, we need net-45 to accommodate our internal vendor payment calendar and will require a PO by the end of the week.

We're fine with the 18% / net-30 + trial extension — please send the updated SOW and DocuSign.

Best,
Ami Lopez
Head of Procurement, Solstice AI
ami.lopez@solstice.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing gate takedown: Solstice AI — outstanding discount & forecast status

Team — good outcome: buyer accepted 18% / net-30 with a one-month trial extension. They agreed to sign the SOW this week and return the DocuSign envelope.

Please update the forecast: move Solstice AI to COMMIT (Q3) at the previously modeled ARR and apply the 18% discount in the pricing model. Karthik — please confirm Deal Desk cleared the concession and capture the approval record in the exception form. Lauren — when DocuSign completes, drop the signed SOW link into the HubSpot deal record.

Impact: this reduces our modeled ARR for the account by ~6.2% vs the 22% ask we were carrying but preserves the Q3 commit, which is preferable to losing the commit. If we don't yet have the signed SOW by Friday EOD, mark as "commit - pending paperwork" and include the deal in the contingency bucket for forecasting calls.

Thanks all — copying Finance ops for visibility.

Ben

Attachment: pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx (updated modeling)
